title.rendered: School Supply Packs – ON SALE NOW

content.rendered:
School Supply Packs for the 2018-2019 school year are available for order now. Contact Michelle Webb at ustwowebbs@yahoo.com with any questions – order deadline is June 24th.

To order online:

·  Go to: educationalproducts.com/shoppacks

·  Enter our school code: MID115

Supply packs will be delivered to your child’s classroom or pod in time for the first day of school.
